page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.4xlarge is a storage-focused instance designed for high-density capacity workloads. Powered by a 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor built on x86_64 architecture, this instance features 16 dedicated vCPUs and 64.0 GB of RAM, yielding a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. Hypervisor execution is managed via KVM.

The defining attribute of the instance is its massive local storage configuration, delivering 47,244 GB of local HDD storage attached to the system. Networking functionality is supported by a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps. The instance operates without discrete GPU acceleration and includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Incorporating extensive local magnetic disk storage offers exceptional volume capacity per instance, making it cost-efficient for mass data archive and processing pipelines that require high throughput over absolute low latency. However, reliance on HDD local media presents sequential read/write access tradeoffs compared to solid-state drive architectures. The system is suited for big data processing, log analysis, data warehousing, and distributed file storage workloads.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.4xlarge is a high-capacity storage server instance utilizing an x86_64 Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. Managed under a KVM hypervisor, it provides 16 dedicated vCPUs alongside 64.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a 4.0 GB per vCPU ratio. A primary feature of this instance is its dense 47,244 GB local HDD storage capacity, combined with a 6 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. The system does not include GPU hardware accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Due to its large mechanical storage volume, the configuration yields high capacity density per server node, balancing core compute capacity with massive local file storage. The ecs.d1.4xlarge instance is suited for storage-heavy application environments, including big data analytics, log retention systems, distributed file infrastructures, and data processing pipelines requiring extensive local storage capacity.
